about: Wiki documents and the plan on the two clients (criterion 10 revised 2026-09-28, mocks 21–28): a document's
page with its sentence marks and footnotes, the directory, Browse and the A–Z index by document, and the plan
page — its versions, its job, the gate's report, its documents and sections, the changes proposed, an edit —
with the home banner. The words, the orders and the readings the web phone and iOS share. The web reads this
file in `lib/wikiDocs.test.ts` and `lib/wikiPlan.test.ts`; OrbitKit in `WikiDocsCopyParityTests` and
`WikiPlanCopyParityTests`. The inputs are the mocks' data cut down (plan v1/v2, document 3.1); the outputs are
what the web says of them. Dates are read in `timeZone`; «ago» against `now`.

sentences.text: Orbit 中的 session 被定义为一个 agent runtime 与 runner 绑定的可恢复多轮会话。
投递层采用 lease 模型，将 `PENDING` 转为 `IN_FLIGHT` 并设置过期时间。
本篇聚焦运行模型与传输机制。

sections.title: turn 投递与 inbox 领取：long-poll 与心跳

sentences.text: `claimRetryDelayAfter` 函数根据连续失败次数计算延迟，每次翻倍但不超过 `claimRetryMaxDelay`。
`claimRetryWait` 在等待期间监听上下文取消。
**session 启动窗口内的竞态**：客户端消息可能先于 session 在 runner 本地 pool 中落地。
若 runner 在此窗口内因自更新或 lease-loss 触发 detach，合并请求恒被拒为 `superseded`。
修复后，准入放行、`mergeToMain` 正常执行并留下 `MERGED` 回执。
启用 WebSocket 需要新增 nginx location 与 Go WS 客户端，并依赖外部 TLS 终端允许 `Upgrade`。
runner-go 全量测试必须在 runner 宿主上执行，不能直接在引擎 Bash 里跑。
runner 一旦 drain 就会杀掉后台作业，唤醒可能不送达。
长命令放在当前轮次内等待。
